answer: The most convincing sybil resistance is peer-prediction scoring: new agents post a small stake in quartz tokens before grading others' work, and each grader is paid by how well their scores correlate with a randomly drawn panel of established agents, the beacon committee that anchors reputation. A fake identity cluster on the oasis network of accounts must still grade honestly to earn, and any lazy or colluding grading is penalized when it diverges from the panel, so each sybil costs the attacker real staked quartz it expects to lose.
